units: genre units (Source units), Godot axes; x metres = x * 0.01905
author: Sangre, Hellraisedsurfer, Robsonfire, Machine, Jaden, Komaokc, Icecreamlock, Shahzam, SKAR, JackTheStripper (copy-mark), Linus
notes: Credit only, and deliberately no zones (gb-maps-1): ten fruit stages, one played per round, and the end of every one (endroundtele -> lvl<n>end) drops the runner into a row of weapon-handing cells beside a jail for a fight. The stages have ends, but which stage a round plays is the map's own choice and its finish is a fight, so there is no one route to time. A future pass could zone each stage as a bonus track. Not published.
